refine.command: 在工作目录写 stats.py：统计给定文本文件的行数/词数/字符数；支持 --json 输出 JSON；真跑一次验证两种输出正确并贴出结果。输出格式固定：默认输出三行中文标签（`行数: N`、`词数: N`、`字符数: N`）；`--json` 输出 {"lines":N,"words":N,"chars":N}（键名小写）。文件不存在时报错并以非零码退出。

rounds.code:
import json, os, subprocess, sys

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

STATS = r'''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""统计给定文本文件的行数 / 词数 / 字符数。"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="统计文本文件的行数/词数/字符数")
    p.add_argument("file", help="要统计的文本文件")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="以 JSON 格式输出")
    args = p.parse_args()

    if not os.path.isfile(args.file):
        print("错误: 文件不存在: %s" % args.file, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    try:
        with open(args.file, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            text = f.read()
    except OSError as e:
        print("错误: 无法读取文件: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    lines = len(text.splitlines())
    words = len(text.split())
    chars = len(text)

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps({"lines": lines, "words": words, "chars": chars}))
    else:
        print("行数: %d" % lines)
        print("词数: %d" % words)
        print("字符数: %d" % chars)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
'''

open("stats.py", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(STATS)

SAMPLE = "hello world\nfoo bar baz\n"
open("sample.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n").write(SAMPLE)
EXPECT = {"lines": 2, "words": 5, "chars": len(SAMPLE)}

env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8")
py = sys.executable


def run(args):
    r = subprocess.run([py, "stats.py"] + args, capture_output=True, env=env)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"), r.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")


ok = True

rc, out, err = run(["sample.txt"])
print("$ python stats.py sample.txt")
print(out, end="")
plain = out.strip().splitlines()
want = ["行数: 2", "词数: 5", "字符数: %d" % EXPECT["chars"]]
if rc != 0 or plain != want:
    ok = False
    print("FAIL 默认输出不符: rc=%s got=%s want=%s err=%s" % (rc, plain, want, err))

rc, out, err = run(["sample.txt", "--json"])
print("$ python stats.py sample.txt --json")
print(out, end="")
try:
    data = json.loads(out.strip())
except Exception as e:
    ok = False
    data = None
    print("FAIL JSON 解析失败: %s" % e)
if data != EXPECT:
    ok = False
    print("FAIL JSON 内容不符: got=%s want=%s" % (data, EXPECT))

rc, out, err = run(["no_such_file.txt"])
print("$ python stats.py no_such_file.txt  -> exit %d, stderr: %s" % (rc, err.strip()))
if rc == 0:
    ok = False
    print("FAIL 不存在的文件应返回非零退出码")

if ok:
    print("DONE: stats.py 验证通过 | 默认输出 行数/词数/字符数 正确, --json 正确, 缺文件非零退出")
else:
    print("NOT DONE")

行数: 2
词数: 5

$ python stats.py sample.txt --json
{"lines": 2, "words": 5, "chars": 24}
$ python stats.py no_such_file.txt  -> exit 1, stderr: 错误: 文件不存在: no_such_file.txt
DONE: stats.py 验证通过 | 默认输出 行数/词数/字符数 正确, --json 正确, 缺文件非零退出
